**Scope:** 2026‑10‑04 00:00 → 2026‑10‑10 23:59:59 (Beijing time). The account matched as *****@***, SSID *****‑1X** (802.1X), wireless controller 172.20.*.*.

**Result breakdown (5,666 events total):**

| Result | Count |
|---|---|
| Authentication succeeded (came online) | **235** |
| Authentication failed | **5,312** |
| Other events (session terminated / logoff) | ~119 |

**By day (rough distribution):**
- 10‑04: 4,664 events (34 of them successful) — the bulk of the activity
- 10‑05 → 10‑09: 742 events
- 10‑10: the remainder, ending with a failure at 23:56:19; last successful login that day was 19:56:38 (AP D5‑6F‑WSJ‑N‑M1)

**Failure types seen** (device reason text, summarised by type):
- AAA returned 26 — "userid error" (account/credential rejected)
- AAA returned 26 — "Mac, IP, NAS‑IP, Port err(29)" (binding/association mismatch)
- AAA returned 8 (authentication rejected)

**Terminals involved:** MACs `327b-0af9-afcd`, `c2e7-d224-4390`, `8091-3397-c3a9`, mostly on VLAN 2381, roaming across APs D5‑6F‑6xx / D5‑5F‑5xx.

**Bottom line:** the account did authenticate successfully (235 successful sessions), but it was overwhelmingly dominated by repeated 802.1X failures — a very high failure-to-success ratio, concentrated on 10‑04. That pattern (repeated "userid error" / MAC‑IP binding errors from multiple MACs) is worth a look: it could be a misconfigured/wrong‑password client, or credential‑guessing against this account. |---|---|
| 2026-10-08 whole day | 10,000 (capped) |

| 2026-10-10 whole day | 10,000 (capped) |
| Each of the 12 six‑hour sub‑windows (00–06, 06–12, 12–18, 18–24 on all 3 days) | 10,000 (capped) |

The backend returns `"total": 10000` with the notice "命中已达 10000 条(ES 仅统计到该值)" — i.e. Elasticsearch only counts up to 10,000, so every window above is a **floor, not a total**.

- **Lower bound: ≥ 120,000 failed Wi‑Fi authentication events** for 2026-10-08 → 10-10 (≥ ~40,000 per day).
- Sanity check on the scale: a single minute sample (2026-10-10 10:00:00–10:00:59) already contained **887** failure events (out of 3,911 total wireless events in that minute), consistent with tens of thousands of failures per day.

Failure reasons seen in the sampled records are dominated by 802.1X/AAA rejections ("AAA processed authentication request and return 26 … Mac, IP, NASip, PORT err"), deauthentication/dissociation packets, and 802.1X user timer timeouts.

Caveats: these are raw event records (the same account/MAC retrying repeatedly appears many times, e.g. `***@***` several times in one second), so this is **not** a count of distinct users; and no narrower filter (e.g. per account) was requested, so an exact figure would require counting hour-by-hour/hour-by-minute slices or an aggregation query on the log platform.

**2024 annual cybersecurity assessment** — "2024 '***' 年度目标任务（网络安全部分考核）", status: 已发布. 71 departments participated, all 71 fully scored.

Scoring is capped differently by category, and ranking is done **only within the same category** (by actual score, descending), so there are two "top" groups:

**Teaching / research units (max 3.5)** — top of category, all at the full 3.5/3.5:
1. ****** — 3.5
2. ****** — 3.5
3. ****** — 3.5
4. ****** — 3.5
5. *** — 3.5
6. ****** — 3.5
7. *** — 3.5
8. 后勤*** — 3.5
(****** also at 3.5; the returned list was truncated, so more units share the full mark)

**Party/government & support units (max 3.0)** — top of category, all at the full 3.0/3.0:
1. *** — 3.0
2. *** — 3.0
3. *** — 3.0
4. 出版社 — 3.0
5. ***（***） — 3.0
…continuing through rank 32 (***) all at 3.0, with no deductions recorded.

Notes on interpretation:
- The "rank 1, 2, 3…" numbers are ordering within a tie of full-mark units, not a quality difference — dozens of units scored the maximum, so no single unit can be called the sole winner.
- The first unit actually below full marks in the returned data is ***: 2.8/3.0, deducted 0.2 on "加强供应链安全，落实网络安全事件整改…" with the reason recorded as "发生一次大量敏感数据泄露并被通报，扣0.2分。"
- Scores across the two categories (3.5 vs 3.0 max) are not comparable, and department names are snapshots from when the assessment was published, so they may differ slightly from today's organizational names.

## 172.20.*.* — what it is

**Hardware asset HD_***** "WEB网关对内提供服务节点使用"** (hostname `xxc_reverse_proxy_185`)

| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| Type / status | Virtualization server, **In use** (available), in service since 2020-07-03 |
| Owner unit | *** / *** |
| OS / specs | Linux (Ubuntu 64-bit), 8 cores, 16 GB RAM, 200 GB disk |
| Network zone | 安全管理地址段 172.20.*.*–172.20.*.* (172.20.1.0/24, VLAN 3, gw 172.20.*.*) |
| Open ports | 22 (SSH), 80, 443, 8000, 8080 (Web) |
| Host agents | Zabbix monitoring client, firewall client |
| Workload | Shared web gateway / reverse-proxy node — carries **200** information assets per the hardware record (IP-based search matches **215** information assets registered on this IP) |

So nothing "application-owned" runs here: it is a **shared front-end node for department websites and campus apps** (e.g. `***.edu.cn` service portal, college/department sites such as ***, ***, ***, ***, ***, ***主页, etc.). Their public domains CNAME to `***.edu.cn` / `***.edu.cn`; the actual application back-ends sit behind it (e.g. 172.28.0.50/51 for the 学工 platform).

## 2. Administrator

- ******* — *** (username 10******)
- Mobile *********** · Email ***@***

(Each hosted website/app additionally has its own business administrator in the owning department — e.g. *** for `***.edu.cn`, *** for the 学工 platform.)

## 3. Bulletins / rectification

- **The node itself (HD_*****): 0 bulletin records.** Its only maintenance log entry is an availability change to "可用" on 2023-10-07.
- **However, applications registered on this IP do have open (未整改) bulletins** — 3 of them, all against *** apps fronted by this gateway:

| Notice | Date | Asset | Issue (as reported) | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| NS_***** (***数信处发2026-60号) | 2026-10-08 | *** (INFO_*****) | Mass sensitive-information disclosure | **未整改** |
| NS_***** (2026-48号) | 2026-09-10 | 学工系统-迎新应用 (INFO_*****) | Broken-access-control (越权) | **未整改** |
| NS_***** (2026-45号) | 2026-09-07 | *** (INFO_*****) | Logic flaw | **未整改** |

App admins: *** (***********, ***@***), ***; vendor 金智教育. Both assets are MLPS level-2 under filing "***" (32111143004-23001), and *** currently has the 2026 policy "夜间关闭校外访问" applied.

Caveat: these findings concern the applications behind the gateway, not the gateway host itself; the other 7 campus-wide 未整改 notices belong to assets on different IPs.
